the partial sum of the singular values can be used to approximate the nuclear norm in low-rank matrix recovery problems, and that the partial sum approach can be applied to low-level vision problems.

a novel formulation for robust principal component analysis, which is based on the idea of partial sum of singular value minimization, instead of the conventional nuclear norm minimization.

a novel approach to robust principal component analysis, which is motivated by the observation that, in many problems, the rank constraint can be used to improve performance of the solution obtained by rank minimization.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we propose a novel approach to robust low rank matrix recovery by exploiting a priori rank information and show that it leads to a better performance than the conventional nuclear norm based approach.
we propose to minimize a partial sum of singular value in place of nuclear norm, and demonstrate its effectiveness for various low-level vision applications.
our method is a better alternative for low-rank recovery problems when the number of observations is deficient.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the partial sum of the singular values can be an alternative to the nuclear norm when the target rank information is known in advance.
, when a target rank is known a priori, partial sum of singular value minimization is a better alternative to conventional nuclear norm minimization for low-level vision problems.
, when the rank of underlying clean data is known a priori, the partial sum of the singular values should be used instead of the nuclear norm in rank minimization.
